references.text: Samson prays to God for strength one last time before he grabs the pillars, which sets up the action in verse 29.
Samson's grip on the pillars leads him to tear down the temple and kill more enemies in his death than during his life.
The Spirit of the Lord comes upon Samson and gives him supernatural strength, just as it does when he grabs the pillars.
The Spirit of the Lord gives Samson power to perform mighty deeds, in the same way as when he tears down the temple.
Samson shows his immense physical strength by lifting the city gates of Gaza, which foreshadows his final display of power.
Samson is mentioned among the heroes of faith who by faith performed mighty deeds and overcame enemies.
